goal_changes.source: trial initial goal (user or unchanged reapplied goal)

limitations: Read-only ROS observations; no contact sensor or ground-truth collision verification
Path length is sampled XY movement with 2 mm noise threshold per 1s snapshot
Status message counts are not time percentages or independent hazard encounters
Data age and receipt age differ; camera-center distance only computed with <=0.2s capture stamp difference
No goal, command, parameter or restart action by monitor
